stories.headline: The Youth Olympic Games open in Dakar, a first for Africa
stories.summary: The Summer Youth Olympic Games opened in Dakar, Senegal, on 31 October. They are the first IOC event to be held in Africa, and they run for 14 days, to 13 November. The programme has 25 sports.

stories.headline: Binance confirms a record $6.3 billion cryptocurrency theft
stories.summary: Digital assets worth US$6.3 billion were stolen from the cryptocurrency exchange Binance on 29 October. It is the largest cryptocurrency heist so far, ahead of the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025. Binance halted all trades at first and says it will cover all losses, and about $3 billion of the stolen stablecoins have been frozen.

stories.headline: An early defensive wall emerges at Oued Beht in Morocco
stories.summary: Excavations at Oued Beht, in the hills of north-west Morocco, have dated a ditch, rampart and wall built across a ridge above a river. The structure is about 4,000 to 3,500 years old. The team says it is the oldest large construction of a likely defensive kind yet confirmed in north Africa beyond the Nile Valley.
